tool.name: Check collection elements by line content
tool.description: list the elements with enough lines, for Filter collection
tool.command: mkdir kept discarded && : > '$kept_identifiers' && #for $index, $element in enumerate($input) #set $identifier = str($element.element_identifier) #set $file_name = '%06d_' % $index + $identifier.replace('/', '_').replace("'", '_') #if $criterion.mode == 'min_lines' result=\$(awk -v skip='$skip_comments' -v nonblank='$criterion.content' '(skip == "yes" && /^#/) { next } (nonblank == "any" || /[^[:space:]]/) { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' '$element') && keep=\$([ "\$result" -ge $criterion.lines ] && echo yes || echo no) && #else keep=\$(awk -v skip='$skip_comments' -v want=$criterion.line '(skip == "yes" && /^#/) { next } { n++ } n == want { if (\$0 ~ /[^[:space:]]/) ok = 1; exit } END { print (ok ? "yes" : "no") }' '$element') && #end if if [ "\$keep" = yes ]; then printf '%s\n' '$identifier' >> '$kept_identifiers' #if $copy_elements && cp '$element' 'kept/${file_name}.${element.ext}' #end if ; else true #if $copy_elements && cp '$element' 'discarded/${file_name}.${element.ext}' #end if ; fi && #end for true

param.name: mode
param.label: Keep an element if
param.option: it has at least N lines

param.name: lines
param.label: N, minimum number of lines
param.help: 2 drops elements that hold a header line only, 1 drops empty elements.

param.name: content
param.label: Lines that count
param.option: only lines with content (not empty, not only spaces or tabs)

param.name: line
param.label: N, line that must have content
param.help: Kept if this line exists and holds more than spaces or tabs. 2 drops elements that hold a header line only.

param.name: copy_elements
param.label: Also output the kept and discarded elements as collections
param.help: Copies the files. Without it, only the list of identifiers is written: give it to the built-in tool Filter collection (from a file), which splits the collection without copying.

param.name: skip_comments
param.label: Ignore lines starting with #
param.help: Comment lines are not counted, and line N is counted without them.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Checks every element of a list collection by its lines and writes the identifiers of the elements that pass. Give that list to the built-in tool **Filter collection** (filter from a file): it splits the original collection into kept and discarded elements without copying any file, so it is fast even for BAMs. Optionally the tool also writes the elements as two collections itself (copies). Typical use: drop per-sample results that hold only a header line, which "Filter empty datasets" keeps because they are not empty.
-----
**Criteria**
*At least N lines* N = 1 drops empty elements, N = 2 drops elements with a header only. Optionally only lines with content count, so a header followed by blank lines is dropped too.
*Line N has content* The element is kept if line N exists and holds more than spaces or tabs.
*Ignore lines starting with #* Comment lines are neither counted nor used as line N.
-----
**Outputs**
- *identifiers kept*: one identifier per line, in the order of the input collection. - *kept* and *discarded* (optional): copies of the elements, with their identifiers and datatypes, in the order of the input collection.
Failed elements cannot be read by any tool; remove them first with "Filter failed datasets".
